purpose: Close the race between one record type's baseline reading and later source changes: obtain a Health Connect changes token with the instant read before requesting it, then durably commit it with a new Initial Snapshot identity in Sender storage before any page is read, abandoning only an attempt the caller names, or begin nothing.

inputs.name: record_type
inputs.description: One record type name from project-source-record's PROJECTION_SCHEMA_VERSIONS, such as steps.

inputs.name: sender_installation
inputs.description: The lowercase UUID of the Sender's own active Sender Installation, supplied by the caller.

inputs.name: abandoning
inputs.description: Absent, or the identity of the record type's current snapshot attempt, which the caller has decided to abandon before first publication.

inputs.name: snapshot_identity_source
inputs.description: A source of random lowercase version 4 UUIDs, one of which becomes the new snapshot identity.

inputs.name: current_time
inputs.description: The time read once from the supplied clock before any Health Connect call, and the commit time.

inputs.name: permission_state
inputs.description: The Health Connect permissions granted to the Sender, read immediately before and immediately after the token request.

inputs.name: health_connect_token
inputs.description: The changes token Health Connect issues for the one record type and every data origin.

inputs.name: sender_storage
inputs.description: The Sender's SQLite database: the record type's current snapshot attempt, read before the token request and again inside the commit transaction.

outputs.name: snapshot_begun
outputs.description: The new snapshot identity, record type, changes token, and unread-since instant, committed durably as the record type's current Initial Snapshot attempt with empty page-chain state.

outputs.name: refusal
outputs.description: A named reason the record type's current attempt prevents beginning, with nothing written and no token requested.

outputs.name: not_permitted
outputs.description: Which required permission was missing, read or history, or that Health Connect denied the request, with nothing written.

outputs.name: read_failure
outputs.description: One named Health Connect failure with no exception text and nothing written, retried on a later run.

outputs.name: storage_failure
outputs.description: The commit failed and rolled back, so nothing was begun; the issued token is discarded and the attempt is retried on a later run.

observable_effects.name: health-connect-token-request
observable_effects.description: Reads granted permissions twice and requests one changes token for one record type and every data origin; never reads records or changes, writes Health Connect data, or requests a permission.

observable_effects.name: sender-storage-write
observable_effects.description: Applies this unit's Sender schema migration, and commits the new attempt, its current-attempt pointer, and any named abandonment in one SQLite transaction or not at all.
